label: Google Drive → Knowledge Base
description: Hourly poll of a Google Drive folder. Lists every file under the folder, downloads each one, and feeds the binary into the Knowledge Base via the Tika document reader. PDFs, Word docs, and plain text are all handled by Tika.

inputs.name: knowledgeBaseId
inputs.label: Target Knowledge Base
inputs.description: The Knowledge Base to load files into.

inputs.name: folderId
inputs.label: Google Drive Folder ID
inputs.description: The folder to sync. Open the folder in Drive — the id is the path segment after /folders/ in the URL.
